age_clock_path.description: JSON clock coefficients. Procedure default is Hannum 2013 (hannum2013_v1.json); operators may overlay Horvath/PhenoAge.
age_clock_path.title: Age Clock Path

bmi_panel_path.description: JSON panel for the BMI/adiposity methylation score. Operator-set path.
bmi_panel_path.title: Bmi Panel Path

contexts.description: Contexts to read for score CpGs. Operator-set; typically [CG].
contexts.title: Contexts

inflammation_panel_path.description: JSON panel for the CRP/inflammation methylation score. Operator-set path.
inflammation_panel_path.title: Inflammation Panel Path

min_coverage.description: Minimum coverage at a panel CpG to include it in the weighted score.
min_coverage.title: Min Coverage

min_sites_fraction.description: Minimum fraction of panel sites observed or the score is marked insufficient.
min_sites_fraction.title: Min Sites Fraction

smoking_panel_path.description: JSON panel (hg38 sites + weights) for the smoking score. Operator-set path.
smoking_panel_path.title: Smoking Panel Path
